# 99. Ska man teckna Anthropic?

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-11-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 99 of Veckans Trade is a solo show by the host, recorded 17 November 2026. It is dominated by Jensen Huang's forced departure from Nvidia after several affairs and alleged leaks to China. The host sold Nvidia at a loss, rotated briefly into Google, and does not want to own Nvidia going forward. He calls the upcoming Anthropic IPO a 'philosophical trade' he will not subscribe to, and says he is long Millicom after an index-exclusion selloff. Sponsor segments add positive views on Addnode, AcadeMedia (Prio Nilsson fund manager) and Camurus (Pareto analyst), and the host is scathing about Cereno Scientific and says the Swedish small-cap market is in a dead calm.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host stopped out after the CEO's ouster and sees poor risk-reward from DOJ, China-leak and governance risk.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. The founder-CEO's departure amid alleged leaks to China creates a crisis of trust. Unknown China sales and possible fines threaten margins and the order book. Without Huang's vision, the high expectations for tonight's report are risky. He prefers chip-owning hyperscalers if Nvidia loses share.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Huang is reinstated
- if Q3 report blows out and DOJ risk fades

> *"Men framöver nu så tror jag att risk-reward att sitta och äga Nvidia inte är jättebra."*

---

### 🟢 TIGO — Millicom | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host bought the drop from $90 to $78 on an MSCI exclusion and the Peru deal rumour; still long at about $83.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. He sees the selloff as a flow-driven overreaction after a strong report. Management is disciplined on acquisitions, cash flow is paying down debt, and owner Xavier Niel is capable. He has no plans to sell below $90.

#### Sell Triggers

- price above $90 (will consider selling)
- if the Peru acquisition proves value-destructive

> *"Jag har inga planer på att sälja i nuläget. Över 90 dollar så får jag väl kika lite."*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet (Google) | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Bought on Nvidia's drop, mostly sold, a small position kept; own chips could make it a long-term winner.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. If DOJ action costs Nvidia market share, Google and Amazon, with in-house AI chips, could gain. He admits his long-term view conflicts with his short-term trading and holds only a small position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if overall AI demand slows

> *"så är nog Google och Amazon långsiktiga vinnare eftersom de utvecklat sina egna chip"*

---

### 🟠 AMZN — Amazon | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

A trading contact bought it; host sees in-house chips as a long-term edge if Nvidia weakens.

#### Reasoning

Cited trader bought it, plus host's thesis. Amazon's own chips could win share if Nvidia is hurt by DOJ action. The host holds no position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if overall AI demand slows

---

### ⛔ ANT — Anthropic | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host won't subscribe to the IPO: a 'philosophical trade' that can't be valued on cash flow, though he expects a 20-30% day-one pop.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. The business is impressive and Claude is embedded in many systems, but the valuation requires believing it becomes the world's largest company. He refuses to invest without a reasonable valuation, while acknowledging that traders subscribing heavily may profit on listing day.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the IPO is priced at a reasonable valuation backed by cash flow

> *"Ja, jag kommer inte teckna i den här IPOn för att jag är en ynkrygg."*

---

### 🟢 CAMX — Camurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Pareto analyst's top healthcare pick ahead of the CAM2029 GEP-NET readout in Q4/Q1, with downside limited by the existing business.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Pareto, Filip Wiberg). Products near 3bn sales at 40% EBIT margin. The GEP-NET superiority study could bring up to 10x peak sales. Few investors want to hold through the readout, so a positive result could trigger strong buying. The delay is likely a good sign.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative GEP-NET readout
- further readout delays

> *"Vi är positiva till Camurus. Det är ett av våra topics inom hälsosektorn."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Prio Nilsson manager added it in summer on a low valuation; Q3 showed operational improvement.

#### Reasoning

Cited fund manager (Martin Lindqvist, sponsor segment). The software-sector selloff left the valuation too low, and Q3 showed signs of operational improvement. The holding was increased and has contributed to returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the operational improvement stalls

> *"Där tyckte vi helt enkelt att värderingen blev för låg här under den här Saas-pokalypsen"*

---

### 🟢 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fund manager increased the holding: political risk overdone, single-digit P/E, few Swedish owners, European M&A.

#### Reasoning

Cited fund manager (Martin Lindqvist, sponsor segment). Political risk is priced too harshly, and positioning is light with few Swedish owners. The earnings multiple is single-digit, and acquisitions in Europe will dilute Swedish political risk over time.

#### Sell Triggers

- adverse Swedish school policy changes

> *"där var väl synen att den politiska risken var överdriven"*

---

### ⛔ CRNO-B — Cereno Scientific | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Market cap below 50m with a 400m rights issue the host doubts will be fully guaranteed; he expects delisting or bankruptcy and alleges insider dumping.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. The company was worth billions months ago and the stock halved in two weeks before a trading halt. The host alleges leaks and market abuse and doubts the legal review's clean bill. He believes the company will go bankrupt.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the rights issue is fully subscribed and clinical progress is shown

> *"Så det här bolaget i princip ska ju avnoteras och kommer gå i konkurs."*
